laws: Books synthesize evidence; they do not replace code, tests, ADRs, missions, receipts or history.
Every current house authority/system/service/structural surface has exactly one Book target.
Quarry stock is cited as provenance and is not promoted by citation.
Book changes grant no execution authority.

books.title: The Book of OTHRYS OS
books.role: The current house: one operating surface over proven V2 machinery.
books.boundary: This book maps the house; it grants no authority and does not rename historical V2 provenance.

books.title: The Book of GPT Control
books.role: Roadmap/control owner that issues bounded missions and preserves the next legal action.
books.boundary: GPT Control plans and governs; it does not self-verify or bypass Trust Canal.

books.title: The Book of Hephaestus
books.role: Engineering authority for bounded construction under mission scope.
books.boundary: Hephaestus builds; it does not ratify evidence, memory, or constitutional authority.

books.title: The Book of Talos
books.boundary: Talos verifies and closes evidence gates; builder success alone is never proof.

books.title: The Book of Trust Canal
books.role: Admission and authority boundary for intents and execution progression.
books.boundary: No operating mode, UI action, model, or Book can grant authority around Trust Canal.

books.title: The Book of Factory
books.role: Oros/product build and refine surface over proven capabilities.
legacy: othrys-hub Factory mission evidence in Mnemosyne estate
books.boundary: Factory composes and refines candidates; operator acceptance and governed release remain separate.

books.title: The Book of Mycelium
books.role: Colony and node routing across OTHRYS machines.
books.boundary: Mycelium routes work; it does not create mission authority or trust a node by presence alone.

books.title: The Book of Command Deck
books.role: Operator workstation and tablet-first control surface.
books.boundary: Presentation may expose authority; presentation never becomes authority.

books.title: The Book of Mnemosyne
books.role: Knowledge governance and institutional memory over explicit evidence.
books.boundary: Mnemosyne admits, classifies, relates, searches, reviews and preserves; it does not research, build, execute, or silently promote.

books.title: The Book of Atlas
books.role: Derived read-only knowledge/system map over Mnemosyne and V2 evidence.
books.boundary: Atlas is a workspace/read model, not a Titan, registry, or authority.

books.title: The Book of Missions and Work
books.role: Mission is canonical execution intent; Work is its durable OS orchestration projection.
books.boundary: Work may organize slices/stages/tasks but cannot replace Mission, Trust Canal, Talos, or receipts.

books.title: The Book of Blocks
books.role: Admitted reusable capability units composed under exact identity and proof.
books.boundary: A Block is not a loose helper or UI feature; unproven stock cannot masquerade as an admitted capability.

books.title: The Book of Oroi and Projects
books.role: Project-local OTHRYS OS objects composed from proven roles, capabilities, knowledge and integrations.
books.boundary: A project manifest is declarative and cannot grant execution authority.

books.title: The Book of Models and Labor
books.role: Replaceable model labor exposed through current project model policy.
books.boundary: Model identity is labor, not authority. Switchyard may select among proven legal labor but cannot grant execution or approval authority.

books.title: The Book of Switchyard
books.role: Deterministic capability and model-labor selection over predeclared legal qualified candidates.
legacy: othrys-hub Mission 008a Auto Frugal evidence in Great Harvest
books.boundary: Switchyard selects and explains; it does not discover credentials, certify builders, grant authority, launch execution, or auto-approve paid escalation.

books.title: The Book of Prometheus
books.role: Intelligence and evidence evaluation over explicit, provenance-bound capability and research evidence.
legacy: othrys-hub Prometheus Gather/Research evidence preserved by the Great Harvest
books.boundary: Prometheus discovers, scores and recommends evidence; it does not admit memory, build, verify execution, own lifecycle cadence, or grant authority.

books.title: The Book of Rhea
books.role: Care and vitality stewardship over explicit system evidence and governed repair requests.
legacy: othrys-hub hub/care/** and Mission 036/037 evidence preserved by the Great Harvest
books.boundary: Rhea interprets vitality, case-manages and requests governed repair; it does not own LIFE, scheduling, engineering, research, memory, credentials, execution verification or approval authority.
